summary: The root HMM primarily signifies conceiving or purposing something in the mind, often with a strong inclination or desire.

headwords.gloss: He purposed, or intended; He meditated, proposed to himself, purposed; intended, to do the thing

parts.t: He meditated, proposed to himself, purposed,
he desired to do the thing,
he endeavoured to do the thing.
He intended it, meant it, desired it.
determined upon it, in his mind.

headwords.def: هَمَّ He purposed, or intended, a thing. هَمٌّ denotes more than إِرَادَةٌ , and less than عَزْمٌ . (Kull, p. 382.) لَا مَهَمَّةَ وَلَا مَكَادَةَ : see art. كود . هَمَّ بِالشَّىْءِ [ He meditated, proposed to himself, purposed, or intended, to do the thing: ] he desired to do the thing, (S, Msb,) without doing it; (Msb;) he endeavoured to do the thing. (S.) هَمَّ بِالأَمْرِ He intended the affair. or purposed it; or he desired it. (Mgh.) هَمَّ بِهِ فِى نَفْسِهِ [aor. هَمُمَ ] He intended it, meant it, desired it. or determined upon it, in his mind. parts.t: he was grieved for him by his affair,

headwords.def: اِهْتَمَّ بِالأَمْرِ He was grieved, and disquieted, by the affair, or case: (TA:) you say اِهْتَمَّ لَهُ بِأَمْرِهِ he was grieved for him by his affair, or case. (S.) [ He was, or became, anxious, disquieted, or grieved, by it.] He minded, or attended to, the affair: (MA:) undertook, or superintended, or managed, the affair. (Msb.) See عُنِىَ , in art. عنى . اِهْتَمَّ لَهُ He cared for, minded, or regarded, him, or it. (Har, p. 94.) اِهْتَمَّ بَلَدَ كَذَا i. q. اِعْتَسَّهُ . (TA in art. عس .)

headwords.gloss: A thing that one meditates, purposes; intends to do; that one desires to do

parts.t: A thing that one meditates, purposes,
endeavours to do; a purpose; an intention;
a faculty firmly rooted in the soul, seeking high things, and fleeing from base things.
Mind; purpose; aspiration; desire; ambition; enterprise; emprise.

headwords.def: هِمَّةٌ A thing that one meditates, purposes, or intends to do; or that one desires to do; or endeavours to do; a purpose; an intention; or an object of desire, or of endeavour; as also . (JK, K.) هِمَّةٌ [ Ambition; particularly of a high kind; ] a faculty firmly rooted in the soul, seeking high things, and fleeing from base things. (Ibn-Kemál, in TA.) See بَعِيدُ , and هَمٌّ . هِمَّةٌ [ Mind; purpose; aspiration; desire; ambition; enterprise; emprise. ] هِمَّةٌ عَالِيَةٌ High purpose; ambition.

headwords.def: هُمَامٌ An aspiring king: (S, K:) a magnanimous, i. e. courageous and liberal, chief. (K.)

headwords.def: هَامَةٌ , pl. هَوَامُّ , Any venomous creeping thing or reptile or the like, that may be killed; such as the scorpion, and the serpent: and (tropical:) a louse; (Mgh:) what has deadly venom; as the scorpion: (Az, Msb:) and sometimes, what is noxious: (Msb:) any reptile or the like, from the louse to the serpent; (AHát, Msb:) but its application to the louse is tropical: (Msb:) any venomous or noxious reptile or the like; such as the scorpion, and the serpent: the like of serpents and scorpions; because they creep ( تَهِمُّ , i. e. تَدِبّ ). (JK.)
